name: Process Data and Sync Folders

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main # Change to 'master' if your default branch is master

jobs:
  run-script-and-sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Run Node.js script
        run: node process-colors.js

      - name: Move contents from data2 to data
        run: |
          mkdir -p data
          cp -r data2/* data/ 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config --global user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add data/ data2/
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "chore: run script and sync data2 to data folder"
          git push
